docs(log): record OpenWiki regen uses OpenRouter, not OpenAI

The repository OpenWiki Update workflow sets OPENWIKI_PROVIDER=openrouter
and OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Local default openwiki still asks for
OPENAI_API_KEY; matching the workflow fails closed without OpenRouter.
